newsitem.title: USA: Fluor unit forms joint venture in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Fluor unit forms joint venture in Europe.

text.p: Fluor Corp's principal operating unit, Fluor Daniel Inc, on Thursday said it would form a joint venture with Assystem SA to provide consulting and technical services to industrial companies in Europe.
The 50/50 venture, called Assystem Services International, will operate in Austria, Britain, Czech Republic, France, Germany, Hungary, the Netherlands, Poland and Switzerland.
Assystem, based in Paris, currently provides a broad range of technical services to industrial clients across France.
Fluor Corp is a global engineering and construction company.
